transcript:
MARTIN: Can you make out the graffiti?

DAVID: It's barely readable... What the..?  It says... It's difficult to read... “I... Can smell... uh... Burning... hair... I can smell burning hair"... Jesus, that's weird... 

MARTIN (CONT’D): That related to the fire?

DAVID: I can't imagine it would've been very easy to write while on fire.

MARTIN: What's it written in? Spraypaint?

DAVID: Don't think so. Lemme take a closer look. 

[SFX: We hear David step closer.]

DAVID: No, it's something brown and... oh, fu... I think it's written in feces. Jesus.

MARTIN: Really? You sure?

DAVID: No. I mean, it's brown and it's starting to chip off. It really looks like-

MARTIN: Maybe it's dried blood?

DAVID: Whatever it is, it's... wait, there's more grafitti on the other wall... Same thing. This wall says "I can smell burning hair" over and over. Maybe two, three dozen times. It looks like it was written in a hurry, too. The letters are overlapping. Not gonna lie, this is pretty eerie....
